notes: The game is melee combat against a curse in a shared clash space - punches and a thrown chair, HP and damage numbers - so it is Action, and nothing else is doing enough work to name second; the first-person camera and the HUD bars are presentation the layout does not decide. The author confirmed three separate worlds in order, classroom then forest sprint then a small cursed combat area, so world-chaptered is the shape and it carries P4, which is the author's own answer rather than a scale estimate, though P4 is not a route that ships today. I took Hack & Slash and kept all three of its options while swapping rooms-sequence for world-chaptered, because a forest is not an enclosed room on a corridor: arena-lockin is the sealed classroom the player cannot leave, spawner-npc is the curse coming through the broken wall, and destructible-cluster is that wall plus the chair that shatters on impact. With no user to ask I read the author's answer that desks and chairs are the fight space as a request for cover-los bent to classroom furniture, and kept the room real-size as they asked rather than oversizing it for the boss.
